Tier 2: Representation & Components. Modify model_design and training_evaluation by adding a learned first-order transition residual inside SASRec, while retaining MultVAE and the successful equal-weight mean-rank ensemble. Reciprocal-rank fusion reduced measured macro HR@10 from 0.620 to 0.605, so the next experiment should improve the sequential representation instead of changing fusion again. The hypothesis is that contextual attention alone does not adequately preserve immediate item-to-item transitions; the reported metrics do not establish this as the cause of the plateau.

In model_design, add a separate trainable source-item embedding table with SASRec’s existing hidden dimension. At each active sequence position, compute a transition logit by taking the source embedding of the current item against the existing candidate-item embedding, then add it to the contextual SASRec logit through a sigmoid gate learned from the contextual feature. Initialize source embeddings with small variance and the gate bias to −2 so the added component starts as a weak residual. Train this component jointly through the unchanged positive-plus-16-negative cross-entropy objective, preserving both existing members’ other architecture, losses, optimization settings, and mean-rank fusion.

In training_evaluation, apply this identical residual scoring operation to training positives, training negatives, local validation candidates, and exported inference candidates. Save the new parameters and architecture configuration, update the predictor writer and loader, and retain checkpoint-reload and generated-predictor agreement checks. Keep all four dataset routes, supplied splits, DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, seed-42 training, the 200-epoch environment default, and fixed validation with 200 users and 99 unique negatives per category; use single-GPU execution within the remaining shared budget. Report measured category and macro HR@10 against the supplied 0.620 reference, print the actual Final Validation Score last, and leave hidden-test access and final held-out prediction generation to the host.
